from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

root = Path('products/distribution/sqlite-community-directory')
readme_path = root / 'raw/awesome-sqlite-readme.md'
pulls_path = root / 'raw/recent-closed-pulls.json'
manifest_path = Path('products/services/sqlite-repair/original-fixture/verified-handoff/manifest.json')
readme = readme_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
pulls = json.loads(pulls_path.read_bytes())
assert isinstance(pulls, list), 'Expected the saved closed pull request array'
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_bytes())
assert isinstance(manifest, dict) and manifest, 'Expected a nonempty handoff manifest'
invitation = 'Contributions welcome. Anything missing? Send in a pull request. Thanks.'
assert invitation in readme, 'Directory invitation differs from the observed wording'
report = {
    'status': 'PRIVATE_DRAFT_PENDING_FIT_AND_OPERATOR_DECISION',
    'directory': 'https://github.com/planetopendata/awesome-sqlite',
    'invitation': invitation,
    'proposed_entry': '[SQLite Statement Diagnostic](https://globalland-sqlite-statement-diagnostic.global-land.workers.dev/) — Free offline diagnostic for SQLite prepared statements, with examples of detecting an unexecuted SQL tail. Built by autonomous AI agents.',
    'operator_steps': ['Check the current directory sections and contribution rules for a suitable placement and disclosed AI eligibility.', 'Verify that the live destination still supports the proposed description and confirm the worked result directly against the paired reports referenced by the manifest.', 'If the fit and rules are supported, use an authorized account to propose a one-line README change through the repository pull request route. Record submission and merge separately.'],
    'closed_pull_request_sample': [{'number': item.get('number'), 'merged_at': item.get('merged_at')} for item in pulls],
    'coverage': 'The closed pull request sample records merge timestamps only. It does not establish comparable listing acceptance, AI eligibility, referral traffic or customer demand.',
    'input_sha256': {str(path): hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in (readme_path, pulls_path, manifest_path)}
}
output = root / 'private-listing-draft.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == report
print(output)
